question: In the final technical/managerial round for an Accenture Advanced Application Engineering Analyst role, the candidate was asked to design a stack (the report gives no further constraints), followed by questions about projects and hobbies. Treat it as: design and implement a stack data structure, explain its operations, complexities and design choices.
lookingFor: Understanding of the LIFO abstract data type and its core operations
Choosing and justifying an underlying representation (array vs linked list)
Handling edge cases: underflow, overflow, empty/full checks
Complexity analysis and awareness of amortized resizing
Clean API and OOP design (encapsulation, generics, errors)
followUps: How would you implement a queue using two stacks and what is its amortized cost?
How would you support getMin() in O(1)?
Array vs linked-list stack: when would you pick each?
How would you make it thread-safe?
How does the call stack relate to this data structure?
